values.note: Non-electric RV or tent site $28, electric site $35; group site $70.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251431/rates (2024 and 2027 rate seasons: RV NONELECTRIC 28, RV Electric 35, RV or Tent nonelectric 28, Tent only 28, Group 70), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Reservations only via recreation.gov'; NPS: 'Walk-ups (same day) reservations are permitted; however, campers will need to make payment online (on a smart phone) or by calling a Recreation.gov representative at 877-444-6777' (cut-off 0). From Easter Sunday until the Sunday after Thanksgiving camping is limited to 14 days at each campground; from the Monday after Thanksgiving to the Saturday before Easter, 30 days total.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251431 (fee description 'Reservations only via recreation.gov'; notice 'OVERNIGHT USE LIMITATIONS'; rules maxStay 14 nights 2026-04-05 to 2026-11-29, maxConsecutiveStay 30 2026-11-30 to 2027-03-28, reservationCutOff 0), read 2026-10-22 + https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (walk-up rule), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: RIDB catalog for 251431 (the 47 current STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251431 ('There are limited sites with RV hook-ups'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 116 sites on recreation.gov: loop A 34 tent-only; loops B and C 47 electric and 34 non-electric RV-or-tent sites (all back-in, listed maximum vehicle lengths 31-47 ft); one group site. 'All equipment must fit on the site pad; large RVs over 25 feet may have to park second vehicles in auxiliary parking away from the campground, or purchase an additional campsite.' The NPS campgrounds page lists 107 sites, hook-ups 'Available at 47 sites'.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/251431/month (the 116 current sites with loop and type) + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + facility notice on equipment, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Showers are outdoor, unheated/cold. A dump and water fill station are directly across Highway 12 at Oregon Inlet Fishing Center, free for campers.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251431 ('Each of the three loops in the campground have a bath house with flush toilets, potable water, and outdoor unheated/cold showers... A dump and water fill station are located directly across Highway 12 at Oregon Inlet Fishing Center and are free of charge for campers'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251431 (notice: 'The Access Pass and both the Senior Annual and Senior Lifetime Pass are the only passes that provide a discount on the fee for the campsite physically occupied by the pass owner... The discount does not apply to utility hookups.'), read 2026-10-22

status.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/conditions.htm (alert 'Cape Point & Frisco campgrounds and several ORV ramps remain closed', naming only those two campgrounds) + recreation.gov availability (sites 'Not Reservable' 2026-10-11 to 10-21 for the storm, bookable again from 2026-10-22 through November), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (Campground Overviews table: Oregon Inlet 'Open year round'), read 2026-10-22

summary: NPS-run (not a concession), reservation-only on recreation.gov (same-day walk-ups book online). Confirmed $28-35 and 50-amp electric with water; added the 14-night limit (30 days in winter), 116 sites (47 electric, all back-in up to 31-47 ft), bathhouses with flush toilets, potable water and cold showers, the dump station across NC 12, the Senior/Access pass discount, and status open: the October 2026 storm alert closes only Cape Point and Frisco, and Oregon Inlet's sites were 'Not Reservable' Oct 11-21 but are bookable from Oct 22. Season year-round confirmed on the NPS campgrounds page ('Open year round'); NPS lists 107 sites against recreation.gov's 116 (34 tent-only). Note kept (AWH).
